title: Shadow Boxing
author: Elizabeth Bloom Albert
problems: Row 6 "partners balance & swing · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 1 are too far apart to balance.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
